items.title: Endoscopic Findings Can Help Predict Cytomegalovirus Colitis after Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation
items.summary: CONCLUSIONS: Ulceration and erosion are independent predictive factors for pathologically diagnosed CMV colitis after allogeneic HSCT. Endoscopic findings may facilitate earlier initiation of CMV colitis treatment.
